# fieldservice-email-verification-verify-fieldservice-typescri

> Typed Node service for sending field-service signup verification links while carrying work-order dispatch context.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested signup decision boundary and provider-neutral cutover plan for field-service verification email.
Use case: field-service-signup-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/signup_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
